title: TRICARE Prime Duplicate Payment Refund Amount
content:
**Clause.** On a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, the installment a duplicate refund concerns is the one against which the payment posted most recently stands. The duplicate refund returns the smaller of the latest payment posted against that installment and its earlier payments together, less the refunds already issued against that latest payment, never more than the amount by which all of its payments exceed the installment's value less those refunds, and that value is the whole annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement; the region keeps nothing of it on the account. The duplicate refund is rounded to the cent, is posted against the latest payment posted against the refunded installment and goes back through that payment's method. The annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

The first installment charge is the installment charge whose coverage period begins on the enrollment's effective date. Where the installment so chosen is the first installment charge of an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year, this policy refunds nothing.

## Parts of the amount

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Excess | all payments posted against the installment less the installment's value, never below zero, rounded to the cent |
| What comes off | refunds already issued against the latest payment posted against the refunded installment come off both the payment the duplicate refund returns and its excess |
| Refund | the payment it returns less what comes off it, never more than the excess less what comes off and less what the region keeps, never below zero, rounded to the cent |

A monthly figure of the annual fee is the annual fee divided by 12, and a quarterly figure the annual fee divided by 4, each rounded to the cent. Month counts run on the calendar, numbered continuously from January 2000.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual arrangement, annual fee 390.12)

| Payments against the installment | Refunds already issued against the latest payment | Excess | Smaller of latest and earlier together | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 390.12 and 390.12 | 0.00 | 390.12 | 390.12 | 390.12 |
| 390.12 and 390.12 | 100.00 | 390.12 | 390.12 | 290.12 |
| 390.12 and 200.00 | 0.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 |
| 390.12 and 200.00 | 50.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 less 50.00, not more than 200.00 less 50.00: 150.00 |
| 390.12 and 390.12 | 390.12 | 390.12 | 390.12 | 0.00 |
